name: percent-20-off-47-50
note: The classic trap: 20% of $47.50 is exactly $9.50, no rounding drift allowed.

name: ten-pct-off-three-33-33-lines
note: 1/3-style split: 10% of 9999 rounds to 1000; largest-remainder gives the tie cent to the first line and the allocations sum exactly.

name: fixed-clamps-to-eligible-subtotal-only
note: The $20 code can only consume the $10 eligible line; the ineligible buyout is untouched.

name: max-30-pct-tax-rounds-half-up
note: 999 * 30% = 299.7 rounds up to 300 at the max allowed tax bound.

name: single-cent-line-50-pct-rounds-up
note: 50% of 1 cent = 0.5 rounds up to 1: the whole cent is discounted.

name: three-single-cent-lines-50-pct
note: 50% of 3 cents = 1.5 -> 2; equal remainders, so the first two lines in order each take a cent.

name: momence-complaint-template
note: Reconstruction of the Momence bug class: a 15% code on three $10.03 lines. Naive per-line rounding gives 150+150+150 = 450 cents off, silently under-applying the advertised percent. The correct compute-once discount is roundHalfUp(3009 * 15%) = 451, allocated 151/150/150 by largest remainder.

name: one-bps-discount
note: 0.01% of $100.00 is exactly 1 cent.

name: fixed-allocation-exact-proportions
note: 100 across weights 300/100 splits exactly 75/25 with no remainders.

name: fixed-allocation-equal-thirds-remainder
note: 100 across three equal lines: 33/33/33 plus the leftover cent to the first line.

name: fixed-allocation-larger-remainder-wins
note: 101 across 500/250: bases 67/33, remainders 250/500 — the leftover cent goes to line b despite line a being first.

name: discount-applies-before-tax
note: Tax is computed on the discounted amount: (10000 - 2000) * 10% = 800, not 1000.

name: allocation-across-taxable-and-nontaxable
note: 10% of 9999 = 1000; bases 333/666, remainders 3333/6666 so line b takes the leftover cent; tax applies only to line a's discounted amount.

name: kitchen-sink-four-lines
note: 15% on eligible 24500 = 3675 exactly, split 675/3000; per-line tax at 8.5% on discounted amounts; tip last.

name: fee-line-not-discount-eligible
note: A $100 fixed code consumes the whole eligible session but never touches the fee.

name: percent-rounds-to-zero-on-one-cent
note: 0.01% of 1 cent = 0.0001 -> 0: a discount can legitimately apply zero cents.

name: equal-remainder-tie-breaks-by-line-order
note: 25 across 100/100: bases 12/12, equal remainders — the first line in order takes the extra cent.

name: per-line-tax-not-order-level-tax
note: Three 105c lines at 5%: per-line tax is 5.25 -> 5 each, total 15. Order-level tax would be 315 * 5% = 15.75 -> 16. The spec is per-line.

name: allocation-follows-line-order-reversed
note: Same lines as allocation-across-taxable-and-nontaxable but in reverse order: the leftover cent still follows the largest remainder (line b), so each id keeps the same allocation.

name: hundred-pct-discount-with-max-tax
note: Fully discounted taxable line at the 30% bound: tax base is zero, so tax is zero.

name: qty-100-seven-pct
note: 7% of 99900 = 6993 exactly.

name: realistic-checkout-two-lines-tax-tip
note: WELCOME10 on 9499 eligible = 949.9 -> 950, split 700/250 (line b has the larger remainder); tax 469 + 168 on the discounted amounts; tip last.
